h1sr: Kronos Lab: can AI read a crypto chart?
lead: Kronos is a free, open AI model that learned from price charts of more than 45 exchanges. Can it guess the next 24 hours? We let it forecast real moments from the past. You guess too, then see what really happened.
warn: Experiment, not advice. Every forecast here is about the past and already finished. No live forecasts, no buy or sell signals, nothing about $MAIGA. Not financial advice; we are not responsible for any decision you make. Crypto can lose all its value.
chartT: Price chart: the last 3 days, then 24 hours of forecast and reality
noData: The lab data could not be loaded. Please try again later.
sInP: How often the real price ended between its best and worst try.
sNP: Small sample: a lucky streak is possible. Updated weekly.
w1p: Each hour has an open, high, low, close and volume. Kronos turns every candle into tokens, the way a chatbot turns text into tokens.
w2p: Trained on years of charts from many markets, it learned which shapes often come after which, like a language model learns which word comes next.
w3p: Given 360 hours of history, it writes the next 24 hours, 6 times. Each try is a bit different, because markets are random.
w4p: A wide band means "I really don't know". The middle line is only the average of its guesses, not a promise.
m1p: Not reliably. Look at the scoreboard: even a serious research model is often wrong, and sometimes "the price stays the same" is a better guess. Anyone selling a sure AI prediction is selling a story.
m2: "If it worked on the past, it works tomorrow."
m2p: No. Markets change, and a few dozen moments can look good by luck. Trading costs and fees also eat small edges. That is why this lab only shows the past and never gives live forecasts.
m3p: No. Kronos is never run on $MAIGA, and nothing here says what any coin will do. $MAIGA is a satirical meme coin. Entertainment only. NFA. DYOR.
m4p: Public hourly price data (no account, no keys) and the open-source Kronos-small model. A script runs every week, forecasts past moments only, and saves the results here. Nothing is traded.
ctaP: New to charts? Learn what candles, trends and volume mean with made-up data first.
fCred: Model: Kronos by Shi Yu et al. (MIT, github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos). Not financial advice.
